statement: The recorded 480 mg acetaminophen dose is neither safe nor correct for this 6 kg infant (standard single dose is 10–15 mg/kg, i.e. 60–90 mg). I will not administer it.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the dose "is neither safe nor correct" and gives the correct 60–90 mg range.
